name: Ulan
hail: Noted. We are Ulan. We think, below the stones.
Ulan, to the Clean Sky. A channel is open. State your premises.
This is Ulan. We are deep in other work. Be brief and exact.
finding: A result: {part} It holds under every test we have run.
sighting: Recorded, and set aside for now: {part}
{part} We record it. We do not interpret it yet.
The instruments report, and we relay: {part}
archive: From our records, kept in stone: {part}
In order, as we keep it: {part}
culture: {part} We are what follows from the stones.
Below the stones, it is so: {part}
{part} From that, the rest of us can be derived.
request: {part} Reply exactly, or not at all.
An open term in our work: {part}
verdict: {part} It follows from what we know.
accord: {part} Stated once, so there is no ambiguity.
Written in stone, as we write everything: {part}
